proof_body:
by
  intro K _ V _ _ _ S T h
  by_contra hne
  have hd : Disjoint S T := by
    refine Submodule.disjoint_def.mpr ?_
    intro x hx hxT
    by_contra hx0
    exact hne ⟨x, hx0, hx, hxT⟩
  exact absurd (Submodule.finrank_add_finrank_le_of_disjoint hd) (not_le.mpr h)
target_source: ∀ (K : Type*) [Field K] (V : Type*) [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [FiniteDimensional K V] (S T : Submodule K V), Module.finrank K V < Module.finrank K ↥S + Module.finrank K ↥T → ∃ x : V, x ≠ 0 ∧ x ∈ S ∧ x ∈ T
